Given the lack of specific evidence in glioblastoma, it's probably a passenger. Therapeutic relevance—no targeted therapy for CREBBP in glioblastoma, so No.

TTN p.R16584H. TTN is a large gene often mutated as a passenger due to its size. In glioblastoma, TTN mutations are generally considered passengers. So classification as passenger with high confidence. No therapeutic relevance.
